Only in this doc. ## bijection_verdict
**KB-BIJECTION: PASS.** No affected document. First revision of this audit.

Observations (not RED):
- K-O1: the lunch-charge factor documents (prepayment_quote_lunch_by_enrolled_campus, sibling_netting_keep_lunch_charge, departed_balance_cover_lunch_charge "a record in any other status does not set the campus") and active_plan_campus_level ("Does the meal account's own campus decide this? No") state the negative of the ladder's record key. Entailed by the ladder; it neither names the baseline reading nor assigns a tier.
- K-O2: both school-year-months factor docs end "This governs repayment payments on every School Nutrition Services Meal Account" though each sits under one plan; the two ladders are identical, so no entailment changes.
